name: set_treasure_opened_flag

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetTreasureOpenedFlag consumes a treasure ID and opened value and passes them to func_0013C5C8, which sets or clears the corresponding persistent bit

notes: func_00151D50 calls the same setter with opened=1 after granting the reward described by D_0034DA40[treasure_id]. All 32 JP calls use literal IDs and opened=1: IDs 258, 423, 424, 425, 426, and 472.
